_comment: gy-53qq5. Which BUILT files must state which of content's ruled prices. Keys name entries of `facts` in gymbo-canonical-strings.json; numbers are NEVER typed here, they are read from the facts at check time, so a price change (content bumps the fact) makes every listed file that still carries the old number go RED. Enumerated from dist/ (what ships), not from src/. A built file that states a current Gymbo amount and is NOT listed here fails as price-unregistered: list it or remove the price. `savePercent` files must also say 'Save N%' with N = annualSavingsPercent. A pinned amount must be in the page's VISIBLE text (a meta, alt, script or comment does not count; gy-53qq5.1 M3), and a savings percent is read in every phrasing ('Save N%', 'N% savings', 'N% off', 'N% cheaper'; M5). A thirdPartyAmounts entry may carry "unit": "percent" to declare a non-Gymbo percentage. Amounts are matched in every spelling (rupee sign raw/entity/split by a React comment or tag, Rs, Rs., INR, 'N rupees', with or without grouping commas). Scope: html/md/txt/xml/json in dist; .js/.svg/.webmanifest are not scanned (gy-53qq5.1 M4, named gap).

thirdPartyAmounts._comment: Every rupee amount in a LISTED file must be a current ruled Gymbo price or be declared here as { file, amount, reason } (gy-53qq5 M1/M2). An amount that is neither is price-unclassified: if it is Gymbo's OLD price it is stale and must be updated; if it is someone else's figure, declare it with the reason. Declared per (file, amount): a Gymbo price that equals a declared figure in the same file is hidden by the declaration (named limit). For an UNLISTED page, a declaration also exempts a third-party amount that happens to equal a current Gymbo price. Read from each sentence in dist on 2026-09-26.
